entries.message: This update includes keep dashboard cards readable in Safari, add a text size slider to the sidebar Appearance panel, up Next order, show grouping, sync activity, and Appearance menu position, restore missing cached posters and keep the app version above the theme switchers, add per-season poster editing for TV shows, season posters on show season rows, open season episodes beside season cards on desktop, seamless season card and episode box join on desktop, match season join outline and transparency in light mode, season joins hold at app zoom, season poster fallback, 5 episodes per row, and manual watch edits skip the restore fence and Backups shows a failed restore.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Keep dashboard history card details visible beside episode artwork across desktop widths.
Give the playlist import dialog more room for its app list.
Text size slider from 100% to 130% in the sidebar Appearance panel scales the text across Plekt
The chosen text size is saved on the Plekt server and applied when Plekt loads
Dashboard history posters use a wider fixed column on desktop so the posters fill the card height
Up Next shows the episode or movie that is playing at the top of the rail while it plays
Up Next shows one card per episode: a part-watched card and a next-up card for the same episode are merged into the part-watched one
Up Next keeps its order on refresh: a card waiting to be removed stays in its place instead of jumping to the top
Appearance sits between Settings and About in the left menu, with the version and light/dark toggle still at the foot
TV shows group and pick posters more reliably when a show has several matching entries
Sync activity refreshes and retries more reliably after a failed request
A cached poster whose file has gone missing is downloaded again when it is next requested, so it shows instead of a broken image
A missing poster that has no downloadable source returns not found, so the artwork fallback is used instead of a broken image
The app version label sits above both theme switches at the foot of the sidebar, instead of between them
Select or upload a poster for each season in Edit Images from TMDB, TVDB, and fanart.tv
Keep season overrides separate so episode, dashboard, and upcoming cards can use them without changing show or episode artwork
Preserve saved season poster choices in portable and encrypted backups
Show page season rows show each season's poster: the poster saved in Edit Images first, then TMDB's.
Specials use the series poster; the row shows a stacked season name, episode count, watch count and next airing.
Up Next cards open their episode from anywhere on the card and show a pointer cursor.
Opening a season on desktop shows its episodes beside the season card, level with it, without pushing the other seasons down
The open season's episode box now lines up with its card, and the outline curves from the card into the box with no seam
Season posters are bigger, with rounded corners and roomier text beside them
Clicking a season scrolls to that season, and the open season no longer shades on hover
In light mode, the open season's episode box and its curved join now use the same outline colour as the season card
In the modern light style, season cards and the episode box are see-through like dark mode, so the backdrop shows behind them
Season episode boxes line up with their open card and the outline joins cleanly when the app is zoomed out; clicking a season scrolls it to the top of the list
Season rows use the series poster when a season has no poster of its own, and one-season shows get posters
Season posters are larger on desktop, and season episodes show five to a row instead of six
Watched-status edits made by you are no longer refused while a watch-history restore is running or has failed; automated sync still waits
Settings > Backups shows a running or failed watch-history restore with its error and a Clear Status button
